description: This PHP source file defines the Startup class within the Opencart administrative model for settings. It provides methods for creating, deleting, updating, retrieving, and counting startup records from the database, following the conventions of the Opencart framework.
external_files: opencart ramework ase classes and DB_PREFIX constant

classes.name: Startup
classes.description: Model class managing startup records in the Opencart admin setting module, providing CRUD and query operations.

methods.name: addStartup
methods.description: Creates a new startup record in the database with provided data.

methods.name: deleteStartup
methods.description: Deletes a startup record identified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteStartupByCode
methods.description: Deletes a startup record identified by its unique code.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a startup record by ID.

methods.name: getStartup
methods.description: Retrieves a startup record by its ID.

methods.name: getStartupByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a startup record by its code.

methods.name: getStartups
methods.description: Fetches a list of startup records, supports pagination and sorting.

methods.name: getTotalStartups
methods.description: Returns the total number of startup records present.
